grammar.title: Placing something with 把...V在
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 把 + 宾语 + 动词 + 在 + 地点
grammar.explanation: Adding 在 (zài) after the verb in a 把 sentence shows exactly where the object ends up — "do X to it, ending up at this place". It's common with verbs like 放, 写, 挂, 停.

grammar.title: Facing a challenge with 面对
grammar.pattern: 面对 + 困难/问题，(主语) + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 面对 (miànduì) means "to face, confront" — usually followed by something difficult like a problem or challenge. It's often used at the start of a sentence to show how someone responds to a situation.

sentences.en: He didn't come home until evening.

sentences.zh: 直到现在，我才明白这件事。
sentences.pinyin: Zhídào xiànzài, wǒ cái míngbai zhè jiàn shì.
sentences.en: It wasn't until now that I understood this matter.

sentences.zh: 直到考试那天，他才开始准备。
sentences.pinyin: Zhídào kǎoshì nà tiān, tā cái kāishǐ zhǔnbèi.
sentences.en: He didn't start preparing until the day of the exam.
